title: VA treatment program with flashing images and constant MRIs while benefits were denied
place_text: VA medical system, while working for BAE

tellings.quote: that this whole thing with these flashing images, MRIs constantly, all of it. And meanwhile, they're denying all of my VA benefits.

plain: In 2017, while working for BAE, a large defence contractor, Dylan Borland says the VA, the US government's health system for military veterans, put him through a treatment programme of flashing images and constant MRI brain scans, while at the same time denying all his veterans' benefits. Borland tells it as his own experience and points to his medical records, as a sign that he was being studied rather than cared for.
